Container.Name: claude-unraid-manager
Container.Overview: FOR EXPERIENCED UNRAID USERS ONLY. Claude Code set up as an Unraid administrator (not a coding tool): an AI assistant that manages containers, storage, VMs, plugins and configuration from the terminal or from your phone via Remote Control. It is meant to ask before it acts; that only holds as long as you keep the permission prompts on and read them.[br][br]Auto-discovers your storage (ZFS, btrfs, array), containers, VMs, plugins, User Scripts and network on every start. Manages containers via the Docker socket; runs host commands through a short-lived helper — no privileged mode needed. Safe defaults: boot drive read-only, no shares mounted. Opt in to more access as needed.[br][br]Requires an Anthropic account (claude.ai subscription or API key). Remote Control needs a claude.ai login.[br][br]BETA: tested on the author's two Unraid 7.3.3 servers (ZFS pool-only), not on a range of setups. It is an AI agent: its rules shape what it does, they do not guarantee it.[br][br]WARNING: The Docker socket gives this container root-equivalent access to your server; the guard rails reduce accidents but are not a security boundary. If you would not do the same work yourself on the Unraid command line, do not install this. Review every action before confirming. Keep backups. The author accepts no liability for data loss or misconfiguration.
Container.Changes: ### 0.1.0-beta.1 (2026-10-14) - First public beta. Tested on two Unraid 7.3.3 servers (ZFS pool-only).

Config.Name: Data (login, settings, history)
Config.Description: Persisted home directory. Holds .claude/ (settings, history) and .claude.json (login). Must survive container rebuilds. Tip: a cache-only (exclusive) appdata share avoids FUSE overhead for the many small history writes.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Working directory. CLAUDE.md is auto-generated here on every start.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Required for container management and host command execution. Without this, Claude is just a code editor.

Config.Name: Unraid Boot Config
Config.Description: Read-only: view plugins, templates, share configs, startup script. Change to rw to let Claude modify Unraid configuration.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Response language (e.g. de, fr, es, nl). Empty = English.

Config.Name: Remote Control Name
Config.Description: Session name shown in the Claude app for phone/tablet access. Empty = container hostname, 'off' = disabled.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to log in with a claude.ai subscription from the attached terminal (required for Remote Control). Set it to bill usage to a Claude Console API key instead.

Config.Name: Resume Conversation
Config.Description: Resume the last conversation on start. Set to false to always start fresh.

Config.Name: tmux Session Name
Config.Description: Name of the persistent tmux session.

Config.Name: Host Helper Image
Config.Description: Image used for the short-lived helper container that runs host commands. Only change this if you mirror images locally.

Config.Name: Container App Data
Config.Description: Optional: mount /mnt/user/appdata here so Claude can inspect container configs and logs. Read-only recommended.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Optional: your media library. Only mount if you want Claude to help organize or manage media files.

Config.Name: VMs
Config.Description: Optional: VM storage for disk image management. Read-write needed for VM operations.
